items.title: Support for Alcoholics Anonymous meeting spaces
items.summary: Councilors are discussing a resolution supporting meeting spaces for Alcoholics Anonymous in Somerville.

items.title: Resident comments on the Warming Center
items.summary: The committee will discuss a resident's written comments about the city's Warming Center.

items.title: Rats and dumpster licensing enforcement update
items.summary: The Director of Public Health will update the council on dumpster licensing, inspections and efforts to keep rats out of dumpsters citywide.

items.title: Winter Warming Center after-action report
items.summary: The Director of Emergency Management presents the review and improvement plan for last winter's Cummings School Warming Center.

items.title: Street harassment near Prescott Street, School Street and Warming Center
items.summary: Health and Human Services will discuss reported street harassment near Prescott Street, School Street and the Warming Center and steps to address it.

items.title: Gilman Square Neighborhood Council comments on McGrath Boulevard
items.summary: The committee will consider neighborhood comments about the McGrath Boulevard project.

items.title: Monthly updates on addressing homelessness
items.summary: The administration will update the committee on progress toward addressing homelessness in Somerville.
